event.title: Trump's Approval Rating Hits Record Low Ahead of Midterm Elections
event.canonical_title: Trump's Approval Rating Hits Record Low Ahead of Midterm Elections
event.summary: President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low of 31%, raising concerns among Republicans as they approach the November midterm elections. The decline in support could jeopardize the party's control of the House of Representatives, prompting discussions about potential gains for Democrats.

timeline.title: Record Early Voting Ahead of Upcoming Midterm Elections
timeline.summary: As the midterm elections approach, over 50 million votes have already been cast, marking a record for early voting. This turnout surpasses the early voting figures from the 2022 midterm elections, indicating heightened engagement from voters as both parties ramp up their campaigns ahead of the polls on Tuesday.
key_facts: Over 50 million votes cast in early voting for the midterm elections.
Early voting numbers exceed those from the 2022 midterm elections.
Both parties are actively campaigning in the lead-up to the elections.
